answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock staking collateral equal to discounted future rewards while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay continuously reprices the bond. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix charges a penalty proportional to the squared stake deviation, giving attackers an expected utility of -e*C < 0. Hence the unique strict Nash equilibrium coincides with honest play, and the protocol reaches its summit as the garden of rational agents becomes a grove of immutable commitments.
